HTF-v3 Data materializer handoff (capability remains fail-closed)

-------------------------

Pinned source descriptor API
----------------------------

#[must_use]
pub(crate) struct MaterializedPinnedResidentCanonicalSourceV1 {
    timeframe: CanonicalTimeframe,
    frame: CanonicalOhlcvFrame,
    binding: SourceArtifactBindingV1,
    source_binding_sha256: [u8; 32],
}

#[must_use]
pub(crate) struct MaterializedPinnedResidentCanonicalSourcesV1 {
    base: MaterializedPinnedResidentCanonicalSourceV1,
    direct_parents: Vec<MaterializedPinnedResidentCanonicalSourceV1>,
}

impl PinnedResidentCanonicalSourceDescriptorV1 {
    pub(crate) fn into_materialized_resident_sources_v1(
        self,
        base_timeframe: CanonicalTimeframe,
    ) -> Result<MaterializedPinnedResidentCanonicalSourcesV1>;
}

The implementation consumes `sources` in sealed
`receipt.direct_timeframes()` order. For every source it reopens the retained
lease with `artifact.lease().reopen_verified()`, decodes that exact Vortex
generation once, and calls `CanonicalOhlcvFrame::from_parts(ohlcv, artifact)`.
It requires exactly one base and every other selected direct timeframe to be
strictly above the base. The full SourceArtifactBindingV1 is domain-separated
and length-framed before SHA-256; using only manifest_hash or vortex_hash is
not an acceptable source-binding identity.

Opaque resident parent capture API
----------------------------------

The only required shared gpu-cuda exposure is crate-private and stays inside
the CUDA crate:

impl ResidentSmcMaterializationV3 {
    pub(crate) fn into_higher_timeframe_parent_parts_v3(
        mut self,
    ) -> Result<
        (
            Box<dyn ResidentParentDatasetSourceV3>,
            Box<dyn ResidentF64FeatureBatchV3>,
        ),
        ResidentFeatureStoreCudaErrorV3,
    >;
}

The owned HTF module should expose one opaque capture, not the concrete SMC,
Classic, Quant, Session, Regime or Footprint batch types:

pub struct ResidentHigherTimeframeDirectParentLaunchPlanV3 {
    // Classic recipe + exact global bindings + pre-device memory receipt;
    // Quant bindings + launch authority;
    // Session bindings + launch authority;
    // Regime bindings + exact scale anchor;
    // Footprint bindings.
}

pub struct PendingResidentHigherTimeframeDirectParentCaptureV3 {
    // Move-owned parent source, canonically tagged feature-major batches, and
    // immutable binding descriptors. No host feature/validity arrays.
}

pub fn capture_resident_higher_timeframe_direct_parent_v3(
    run_device: &GpuOnlyRunDeviceAdmissionV3,
    smc: ResidentSmcMaterializationV3,
    plan: ResidentHigherTimeframeDirectParentLaunchPlanV3,
) -> Result<
    PendingResidentHigherTimeframeDirectParentCaptureV3,
    ResidentFeatureStoreCudaErrorV3,
>;

impl PendingResidentHigherTimeframeDirectParentCaptureV3 {
    pub fn route_descriptors(&self) -> &[ResidentHigherTimeframeCapturedRouteV3];
    pub fn rows(&self) -> usize;
    pub fn retained_device_bytes(&self) -> usize;
    pub fn context_process_token(&self) -> [u8; 32];
    pub fn stream_process_token(&self) -> [u8; 32];
    pub fn into_direct_parent(
        self,
        authority: ResidentHigherTimeframeParentAuthorityV3,
    ) -> Result<ResidentHigherTimeframeDirectParentV3, ResidentFeatureStoreCudaErrorV3>;
}

Capture launches in exact CPU producer order:
SMC -> every Classic recipe batch -> Quant -> Session -> Regime -> Footprint.
It moves each feature-major batch into the capture. It must never call
append_batch, pack feature-major to bar-major, copy_to, or synchronize.

Required Data factory seam
--------------------------

fn prepare_direct_parent_htf_v3(
    &mut self,
    run_device: &GpuOnlyRunDeviceAdmissionV3,
) -> Result<
    PendingResidentHigherTimeframeRuntimeV3<
        PendingResidentHigherTimeframeDirectParentCaptureV3,
    >,
    GpuOnlyFeatureMaterializationErrorV3,
>;

For each direct parent, this method moves the canonical timestamp Vec used at
that same SMC upload call, the source-binding digest, and the opaque capture
into `retain_live_resident_higher_timeframe_parent_v3`. It then calls
`preflight_resident_higher_timeframe_alignment_v3` once over all selected
parents. No fixed route census is supplied.

Hard architecture blocker
-------------------------

On the guarded preimages, ResidentSmcMaterializationV3 keeps `parent` and
`batch` private, while every normal assembler append immediately packs and
event-retires the feature-major batch. The sealed bar-major store is not a
valid substitute for the HTF feature-major pointer/offset ABI. Therefore no
legal current call path can retain direct-parent features without either the
opaque capture above or a forbidden device-to-host/device round trip.

Do not register resident_higher_timeframe_capability_v3 until this capture,
Data runtime evidence attachment, strict build, route/value/validity parity,
and release census all close.
